title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations
scheme: Scheme-I / National Electrical Code of India (SP 30)
source_authority: Bureau of Indian Standards / Central Electricity Authority

clauses.title: Sizing of Circuit Conductors and Voltage Drop Limits
clauses.text: Clause 5.4: Copper conductors shall have minimum cross-sectional area of 1.5 mm² for lighting sub-circuits and 2.5 mm² for 16A power sub-circuits. Voltage drop from consumer intake point to any terminal outlet shall not exceed 4 percent of nominal supply voltage.

clauses.title: Mandatory Earthing Resistance and Shock Protection
clauses.text: Clause 9.1: Total earth loop impedance and earth electrode resistance for residential premises shall not exceed 5.0 Ohms. Independent earth pits must connect to main switchboard earth bar using copper earth strip of minimum 25x3 mm.
